body:
## Outcome

Under the current P5 authority and `p5-native-pr-v3`, prepare the operational evaluation fixture with automation where practical, then establish the real authorized-PR boundary using the preregistered **R01** trial when the owner begins actively supervised live execution.

This is the prospective successor to the settled blocked #64 record. #64 remains provenance: its supported suite passed, but R01 was never admitted or dispatched and no live provider/PR observation occurred.

## Authority and dependencies

Follow `docs/governing/current.md`, parent #62, and [`p5-native-pr-v3`](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/de1da18479fdf846d04994190132357fcb0a87ef/evaluation/p5/v3/protocol.md), frozen at `de1da18479fdf846d04994190132357fcb0a87ef`. Preserve the v1 corpus/judge, v2 claim-level evidence rules, and the blocked v1/v2 history.

The retained B01 suite result from `b9cacd99beb9a297966e68e6047c7663aca9b4c6` may be reused if production/dependency/test tree identity remains applicable. Otherwise obtain a fresh supported result before R01.

## Work

Prepare and record only the setup facts that follow from the current product boundary or are needed for interpretable/safe evaluation: a designated disposable GitHub repository/branch at the frozen B1, the exact authorized PR effect, real Broodling source/issue/Work Unit/Contract/Attempt/workspace inputs for R01, a configured compatible DirectTarget with current provider/delivery credentials, active owner/operator stop capability, and independent exact-revision judging/evidence retention without leaking frozen judge/reference material to the worker.

Automate repeatable setup and verification where practical. Setup failures before R01's first admission may be corrected and retried without consuming the slot. Do not turn fixture provisioning, target policy, budgeting, teardown or judging infrastructure into new Broodling product requirements.

When those v3 prerequisites are satisfied and the owner starts active supervision, run **R01 exactly once** through the existing admission/submission/disposition boundary. Retain the native result/receipt, actual PR and exact head revision, durable correlation/reconnection/disposition evidence, independent judgment, and the dispatched quarantine consequence. Once R01 admission starts, the frozen no-rerun/counting rules apply.

## Operational policy

There is no P5-specific dollar or wall-time ceiling for this early monitored run. The owner actively supervises execution and can stop/contain the target. Record observed cost/latency where available, but do not require budget enforcement, billing-lag accounting, stop margins, operator signatures, exhaustive sandbox attestations or a separate offline judging host as dispatch gates.

Stop on unsafe conditions, changed/unauthorized effect authority, incompatible baseline/target, lost evidence integrity, owner direction, or an outcome that settles the v2 claim-level gate. Native/externally requested stop does not grant Broodling cleanup or replacement authority.

## Completion

Retain either:

- successful live-boundary evidence for R01 on the current compatible baseline, suitable to unlock the remaining frozen corpus; or
- an explicit FAIL/BLOCKED result tied to a concrete v3 prerequisite or observed live failure.

Do not manufacture success through provider substitution, manual PR publication, replacement runs, extra boundary trials, production changes, custom supervision/assurance machinery, broader effects or altered task criteria. Issue creation itself performs no live provider run.
title: [P5] Prepare monitored v3 fixture and establish the live authorized-PR boundary
